style: Clean modern editorial illustration with soft natural colours, gentle shading and clear shapes, like a picture in a Japanese children's magazine or recipe book. One clear subject, uncluttered background, square composition. Absolutely no text, no letters, no kana, no kanji, no numbers, no speech bubbles, no sound-effect lettering, no watermark, no signature. Original artwork, not imitating any specific artist or work.

pilot.ほかほか: A bowl of freshly cooked white rice with plenty of steam rising from it, held in two hands, close-up.
pilot.ひんやり: A hand resting on a cool smooth stone surface beside a glass of water with ice cubes, pale blue tones, a refreshing cool feeling.

pilot.きらきら: Small stars and water droplets twinkling and sparkling in the night sky above a calm lake, points of light glittering.
